name: iacg-wrapup
purpose: Decision guide for unanswered questions (never fabricate a STATED value; record flagged DEFAULTs) plus a final summary of finished work: what was asked, assumed, decided, and what still needs the user.
never_do: present an assumed value as something the user stated
bypass a MUST_ASK gate by inventing an answer
skip the assumed / still-open sections of the summary
claim a check passed that did not run

provenance.source_reference: Owner: the agent asked questions, timed out, then 'made up the value and moved on'. Wants a decision guide + a summary of finished work and unanswered questions.
